scenarios.name: no_costs
scenarios.basis: theoretical: what the signals are worth before anybody is paid

scenarios.name: legacy
scenarios.description: Published model: 0.10% fee + fixed 5 bps slippage, always filled

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.description: Base estimate: spread and impact from liquidity and volatility
scenarios.basis: fee observed; spread and impact estimated (snapshot fit); participation assumed 1%

scenarios.name: high
scenarios.description: High costs: spread x3.3, impact coefficient 1.81

scenarios.name: stressed_slippage
scenarios.description: Stressed slippage: spread x10, impact coefficient 6.55
scenarios.basis: assumed stress beyond the observed 90th percentile

scenarios.name: delay_1h
scenarios.description: Orders reach the market 1 hour after the candle opens
scenarios.basis: fill price observed: open of the hourly candle

scenarios.name: delay_4h
scenarios.description: Orders reach the market 4 hours after the candle opens
scenarios.basis: fill price observed: open of the hourly candle

scenarios.name: delay_1_candle
scenarios.description: Orders reach the market one whole candle (1 day) late
scenarios.basis: fill price observed: open of the next candle

scenarios.name: rejections_10pct
scenarios.description: 10% of orders refused by the venue (20 random draws)
scenarios.basis: assumed rate; entries are not chased, exits are retried next candle

scenarios.name: combined_worst
scenarios.description: High costs + 10x thinner + 4h delay + 10% rejections (20 draws)
